summary: Implemented the review-fix patch for mentor workspace backfill with constrained scope: conflict-safe alias handling, explicit repair gate to eliminate default write-on-read in mentor GET flows, and expanded idempotency/negative-path coverage while preserving endpoint contracts.
decisions: Added explicit conflict guard in `ProductAssignmentRepository.backfill_active_provider_ids`: divergent non-empty `provider_id` and `mentor_id` are preserved (no overwrite) and counted as conflicts.
Introduced explicit runtime gate for repair/backfill during mentor reads via `MENTOR_WORKSPACE_BACKFILL_REPAIR_ENABLED` (alias: `MENTOR_WORKSPACE_BACKFILL_ON_READ`).
Kept mentor endpoint payload contracts unchanged and added API coverage proving contract continuity with repair enabled.
Added second-pass idempotency assertions at repository and API level (`updated == 0` / stable `updated_at`).
Added regression coverage for inactive rows and divergent alias conflict scenarios.

risks.risk: With repair gate disabled by default, legacy corrupted rows are no longer auto-healed on GET and require explicit migration/repair execution.
Divergent alias rows are intentionally left untouched; operators need a remediation path for conflicted records.
